subject: Civil Engineering
title: Metro Systems: Underground Transit
description: A short lesson to help you apply Metro Systems: Underground Transit.

hook.text: London opened the world's first metro in 1863 — steam trains in tunnels full of smoke.

buildup.text: Metro lines move millions daily. Stations need platforms, ventilation, and emergency exits.

discovery.text: Cut-and-cover digs a trench from the surface. Boring machines tunnel deeper without disruption.

twist.text: Deep stations need escalators hundreds of feet long — Moscow's stations descend 250 feet.

climax.text: Automated metros in Dubai and Copenhagen run driverless — fully computer-controlled.

punchline.text: Bury the transit and the city above breathes freely.

quiz.question: What is the cut-and-cover method in metro construction?
options: Tunneling deep underground with a boring machine
Digging a trench from the surface, building the tunnel, then covering it
Suspending rail tracks on elevated pillars above streets
